title: The Witnesses
opening: Talented artist Clara Vale is found dead in her studio during her private exhibition. Her devoted assistant Anna is found next to her body with something red on her hands.

suspects.name: Anna
suspects.description: Clara's loyal assistant. She was found beside Clara's body with something red covering her hands.

suspects.name: Elliot Grim
suspects.description: An old friend of Clara and a struggling artist. Several guests saw him arguing with Clara earlier that evening.

suspects.name: Julian Mercer
suspects.description: A successful artist and one of Clara's closest friends for more than fifteen years. He was seen leaving Clara's studio not long before she was found dead.

other_people.name: Gideon Crane
other_people.description: Clara's eccentric spiritual therapist. He believes Clara had been deeply troubled in the weeks before her death.

evidence.name: Clara's Body
evidence.description: Clara Vale lies motionless on the floor of her studio. There is an apparent head injury.

evidence.name: Red Substance
evidence.description: A pool of deep red substance lies near Clara's body. The same substance covers Anna's hands.

evidence.name: Bronze Sculpture
evidence.description: A heavy bronze sculpture is found near Clara's body.

clues.name: Crimson Oil Paint
clues.description: The red substance beside Clara's body and on Anna's hands is crimson oil paint, not blood.

locations.name: Clara's Studio
locations.description: Clara's private workspace on the upper floor. Her body was discovered here.

locations.name: Exhibition Gallery
locations.description: The room where Clara's new collection, The Witnesses, is being displayed.

locations.name: Dining Room
locations.description: The main dining room where Clara and her guests ate earlier that evening.

locations.name: Upstairs Hallway
locations.description: A corridor that connects Clara's studio to the rest of the house.
